items.headline: Manchester United close summer window with midfield rebuild but no striker or left-back
items.summary: Transfer window ended Sept 1. United signed Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans and Carlos Baleba but failed to add a new striker or left-back ahead of Champions League return.

items.headline: Manchester United had unsuccessful left-back search before deadline
items.summary: United failed to sign left-back targets including Lewis Hall from Newcastle. Valued Hall at £50m but Newcastle refused to sell.

items.headline: Jadon Sancho confirms two-year deal with Palmeiras after Manchester United exit
items.summary: Sancho agreed two-year Palmeiras contract after leaving Manchester United, with third season option and official confirmation pending.

items.headline: JJ Gabriel trains with first team ahead of Everton fixture
items.summary: 15-year-old academy prospect JJ Gabriel involved in first-team training preparations before upcoming Everton match.
